 T-groove plates 
 T-groove plates
T-groove plates are used for testing components, among other things. They can be optionally extended with an air cushion pallet and parking table for moving heavy fixtures in and out of the test area. This makes it easier to switch between different test types. They are available in different sizes and different T-groove geometries.
T-groove plate rectangular 1000x1000 mm
T-groove plate for pull-out tests on welded bolts on sheet metal components
T-groove plate with air cushion pallet and parking table

 Aerospace 
 Testing technology for aerospace
In aerospace, maximum lightweight construction and the highest material quality are crucial. Materials such as carbon fiber reinforced plastics (CFRP), sandwich structures, and high-performance metals must prove themselves in demanding, standard-compliant testing procedures. Hegewald & Peschke offers precise and flexibly configurable testing systems for this purpose.
Our universal testing machines with integrable temperature control chambers or high-temperature furnaces enable tensile, compression, bending, and peel tests on components made of aluminum, steel, or composite materials, depending on the design, at temperatures ranging from -70°C to +1200°C. Thanks to the expandable test chamber and T-groove plate, even large-format components can be tested safely and efficiently.

Carbon fiber reinforced plastics (CFRP), commonly known as carbon, are characterized by their high strength combined with low weight. These properties make them ideal for applications in aerospace, automotive, and sports equipment industries. The testing system is used to determine the mechanical properties of composite samples by means of tensile tests (e.g. according to ASTM D3039 & DIN EN ISO 527) and bending tests (e.g. according to ASTM D790 & DIN EN ISO 14125.

 Bicycles & E-bikes 
 Testing technology for bicycles, bicycle components, and e-bikes
Bicycles and e-bikes are at the heart of modern mobility solutions, whether for everyday use or leisure activities. To meet the growing demands for safety, durability, and comfort, reliable testing procedures throughout the entire development and production process are essential. Hegewald & Peschke offers a wide range of testing systems for the mechanical testing of bicycles and e-bikes as well as their components and materials.
Our solutions range from universal testing machines with extensive accessories to specialized test rigs for component and overall testing to flexible system concepts for fatigue testing, long-term behavior, and overload testing. In this way, we support manufacturers, suppliers, and testing institutes in meeting the highest quality and safety standards, regardless of whether child seats, luggage racks, or complete bicycles and e-bikes are being tested.
 Prüfstände für Fahrradrahmen, Komponenten und Zubehör
Our specially developed test rigs for bicycle components enable precise and standard-compliant testing in accordance with all relevant standards, including DIN EN 14344 (child seats) and DIN EN ISO 11243 (luggage racks).
 Testing of luggage racks in accordance with DIN EN ISO 11243
 Test rigs for bicycle luggage racks
Possible tests: 
Vertical dynamic test according to DIN EN ISO 11243, section 5.9.3 
Lateral dynamic test according to DIN EN ISO 11243, section 5.9.4 
Test system: 
Test rig with touch panel and PLC control 
Setting of cycle number, speed/frequency, stroke, and swivel angle  
more
Further information on testing bicycle luggage racks
 Testing of child seats in accordance with DIN EN 14344
 Test rigs for bicycle child seats
Possible tests: 
Vertical test according to DIN EN 14344 Section 8.9.3.5.2 
Side test according to DIN EN 14344 Section 8.9.3.5.3 
Transverse stiffness test according to DIN EN 14344 paragraph 8.9.3.6 
Test system: 
Various models: 
Double test rig for vertical, lateral, and transverse stiffness testing 
Single test rig for vertical testing 
Single test rig for lateral and transverse stiffness testing 
Operation via touchscreen with PLC control: 
Input of target cycle count and any additional test parameters (e.g., swivel angle) 
Display of set speed and actual cycle count 
Automatic stop after reaching the target cycle count 
more
Further information on testing bicycle child seats
 Tests with universal testing machines
The inspekt table universal testing machine is used in combination with a T-groove plate for fastening to perform mechanical testing of bicycle accessories made of polymers and foams, such as saddles. A compression plate and a peel device are used to apply the load. The system is controlled by the intuitive LabMaster testing software, supplemented by a video recording module that visually documents the test sequences and makes them evaluable.
This system can be used to perform the following tests, among others: 
Tensile tests in accordance with DIN EN ISO 1798 (polymer foams) and DIN 53504 (elastomers) to determine tear resistance and elongation behavior 
Compression tests according to ISO 604, ISO 7743, ISO 844, ISO 3386-1 and -2 – optionally also cyclic or with defined force holding and force paths 
Creep and stress-rupture tests according to DIN EN ISO 10066, ISO 1856, ISO 3384, ISO 8013, and ISO 6914 to evaluate the long-term behavior of materials 
Peel tests according to ISO 15113 to analyze the adhesive strength of multilayer materials and bonds 
Further information on the inspekt table universal testing machine
 Flexible test rigs for individual requirements
With the Calmar pro.2 system, Hegewald & Peschke offers a powerful platform for modular component testing. Pneumatic and electric motor axes can be freely combined for single- and multi-axis applications depending on the application – ideal for: 
Fatigue testing on frames, forks, handlebars, stems, or seat posts 
Stiffness measurements and bending tests on handlebar units or frame assemblies 
Maximum load and overload tests to validate extreme operating conditions 
Reproducible load cycle tests in accordance with DIN EN ISO/IEC 17025 
The testing systems are compatible with all relevant bicycle standards, including DIN EN ISO 4210, the European standard EN 15194 (for e-bikes/pedelecs), and the new DIN EN 17860. Their high flexibility makes them suitable for both standard testing and individual development tests – whether in the laboratory or in quality assurance.
Further information on test benches of the Calmar pro.2 series
 The right testing software for testing bicycles and e-bikes
Our test systems are equipped with the LabMaster test software, which enables user-friendly setup and procession of the test procedures for customised tests. It guarantees fast and reliable determination of results and offers a high degree of flexibility when integrating external measuring devices. Data import and export for customised software such as QDAS or SAP is also possible.
